_doc: FA1 first-person arms (src/fps_arms.cpp, docs/fps-arms.md). Where the hands go is measured on each weapon's mesh at its grip sockets (the trigger hand's palm on the right face of the stock wrist / pistol grip, the support hand's palm under the fore-end, knuckles at the far edge). Each hand's orientation in weapon space (x toward the shooter's LEFT (the viewmodel turns the weapon 180 degrees about y), y up, z toward the muzzle): pinky = the grip axis from the index finger toward the little finger (the line the fingers curl about), palm = the palm's outward normal. curl: degrees toward the palm [proximal, distal] for the fingers (middle to pinky) and the index finger, thumb one angle. contact (optional): the grip point in the hand frame [along the fingers from the wrist, toward the pinky, out of the palm] (m). soften (optional, 0..1): turn the hand toward the forearm. styles: shared specs a weapon names with "style". weapons: per weapon id, keys replacing the default; left "free": true keeps the support hand off the weapon. shoulderR / shoulderL: the shoulders in camera space (x right, y up, -z forward), behind and below the eye. sightConeDeg: in ADS nothing of the arms may sit within this angle of the sight line (the support hand is lowered, else the arm is not drawn); nearClear: an arm with any part closer than this (m) to the eye within 27 degrees of the view centre is not drawn (nearClearAds in ADS: the trigger arm sits at the cheek).
